answer: Use parish councillor tenure with council meeting records as the proof: meetings attended on one council for years. One fake is cheap, but 141 aliases need 141 independent meeting records, and the time invested in each is the price the farm pays. Each epoch demands a fresh attestation from the issuer, and stale or copied records fail the check. The onyx check runs in the open: 141 fakes pay the full price 141 times, one honest agent pays once, and the mirror trail in the ledger makes the lantern cost visible to everyone.
